Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem document. This is the entry point's default error shape, which a host-supplied ErrorResponder may replace.

detail.description: A longer explanation of this occurrence, present only when the answering module has one to give. It may be a sentence rendered in the request language or a language-neutral token such as "forbidden", so clients must not parse it.

instance.description: A URI identifying this occurrence; absent when there is none to give.

status.description: The HTTP status code the response is written with, repeated from the status line.

title.description: A short summary of the kind of problem. A module that sets none gets the standard English status text for the status code.

type.description: The machine-readable code identifying the kind of problem. A module that sets none gets the RFC 9457 default about:blank; codes this platform defines are URNs of the form urn:speed:<capability>:<code>.

account.description: The account identifier of the active member the request names as the next owner.

TenantTransferView.description: One pending or finished owner-transfer request on the organization's own surface.

expires_at.description: When the confirmation window closes, as an RFC 3339 instant in UTC.

id.description: The request identifier the target and the canonical paths address.

requested_at.description: When the request was made, as an RFC 3339 instant in UTC.

status.description: The request's state. Only pending requests can be cancelled or confirmed.

target_display_name.description: The target account's display name. Empty when the account store does not resolve it.

target_username.description: The target account's username. Empty when the account store does not resolve it.

delete.description: Deletes one organization, called by the organization's current owner. The tenant surface decides by owner identity: the acting account must be the row's OwnerAccount, and no platform permission is asked. The write is a tombstone: the identifier and the name stay and are never reusable, and the organization's memberships, bindings, roles and grants are removed in the same transaction, under the same tenant lock the platform surface takes. A protected tenant is refused by the host's write guard. A mandatory audit row lands before the write; if it cannot, nothing is written and the request is answered 503. A tombstone is a 409: deletion is terminal.

parameters.description: The tenant's name. The path-tenant layer resolves it to the internal identifier before the handler runs, holds it to the tenant the request resolved to, and refuses the platform domain; a name no tenant carries is a 404.
parameters.name: tenant

400.description: The name is outside the slug domain

403.description: The caller is not the organization's owner, the caller has not proved an email address (contact-required), or the tenant is protected (urn:speed:tenant:protected)

404.description: No tenant carries the name, or the path tenant is not the tenant the request resolved to or is the platform domain

409.description: The tenant is a tombstone, or the caller stopped owning the organization before the write committed

post.description: Records a pending request to hand one organization's ownership to an active member, called by the organization's current owner. The tenant surface decides by owner identity: the acting account must be the row's OwnerAccount, and no platform permission is asked. Ownership does not change until the target confirms. A mandatory audit row lands before the write; if it cannot, nothing is written and the request is answered 503.

parameters.description: The tenant's name. The path-tenant layer resolves it to the internal identifier before the handler runs, holds it to the tenant the request resolved to, and refuses the platform domain; a name no tenant carries is a 404.
parameters.name: tenant

requestBody.description: The account identifier of the active member the request names as the next owner.

schema.description: The owner-transfer request as recorded, pending.

request.description: The pending request. Ownership has not changed.
